<!-- TDB page compatibility CSS v1.0.0 | legacy non-home components; preserves first paint | SHA 3c09843 -->
<link rel="stylesheet" data-tdb-page-compat href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/TheDentalBarns/tdb-webflow-runtime@3c0984362573aa1a0460dcc4fb86be61010890b4/dist/tdb-page-compat.css">
<style>
  * {
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    -ms-user-select: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  }

  .selectable {
    user-select: text !important;
    -webkit-user-select: text !important;
    -ms-user-select: text !important;
  }
</style>
<style data-tdb-service-entry-switches>
[data-tdb-experience-entry] h2{margin:1.5rem 0 2rem}
[data-tdb-experience-entry] .button{margin-top:1.5rem;width:fit-content}
[data-tdb-experience-entry] img{filter:brightness(0)}
</style><style data-tdb-native-entry-visibility>
[data-tdb-service-calculator],[data-tdb-service-experience]{display:none}
body:has([data-tdb-calculator-enabled]:not(.w-condition-invisible)) [data-tdb-service-calculator],body:has([data-tdb-experience-enabled]:not(.w-condition-invisible)) [data-tdb-service-experience]{display:block}
[data-tdb-calculator-enabled],[data-tdb-experience-enabled]{display:none!important}
</style>
<style data-tdb-senses-loading-shared>.tdb-senses-loading{box-sizing:border-box;position:fixed;inset:0;max-width:none;max-height:none;width:100%;height:100%;height:100dvh;margin:0;padding:0;border:0;overflow:hidden;background:#eeeae2;color:#252822;font-family:"Sweet Sans Pro x",Verdana,sans-serif}
.tdb-senses-loading::backdrop{background:#eeeae2}
.tdb-senses-loading-view{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;gap:23px;text-align:center;padding:30px}
.tdb-senses-loading-ring{height:44px;width:44px;border:1px solid #c4c8bb;border-top-color:#48563c;border-radius:50%;animation:tdb-entry-turn 1.6s linear infinite}
.tdb-senses-loading-text{margin:0;font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;letter-spacing:.06em}
.tdb-senses-loading-close{position:absolute;top:max(22px,env(safe-area-inset-top));right:3vw;z-index:2;width:44px;height:44px;border:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:300 29px/1 Verdana,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
.tdb-senses-loading-retry{border:1px solid #92978b;background:transparent;border-radius:40px;padding:12px 25px;color:inherit;font:inherit;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer}
.tdb-senses-loading button:focus-visible{outline:1px solid currentColor;outline-offset:5px}
.tdb-senses-loading-close{right:5vw}
.tdb-senses-loading-ring{animation:tdb-entry-turn 1.6s linear infinite}@keyframes tdb-entry-turn{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}</style><style data-tdb-senses-refinement>
.tdb-senses .tdb-senses-title{font-weight:300!important}
.tdb-senses,.tdb-senses-loading{outline:none!important}
.tdb-senses :focus:not(:focus-visible),.tdb-senses-loading :focus:not(:focus-visible),.tdb-senses-entry :focus:not(:focus-visible){outline:none!important}
.tdb-senses :focus-visible,.tdb-senses-loading :focus-visible,.tdb-senses-entry :focus-visible,[data-tdb-experience-entry] :focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--base-color-brand--orange-3,#d6cab4)!important;outline-offset:4px}
[data-tdb-experience-entry] .button{display:inline-flex;width:fit-content;max-width:100%;justify-self:start;align-self:flex-start;flex:0 0 auto}
@keyframes tdb-senses-dd{0%{opacity:0}50%,75%{opacity:.5}100%{opacity:.1}}
@supports(animation-timeline:view()){[data-tdb-experience-entry] .text-style-tagline-restored,.tdb-senses-entry-kicker{animation:tdb-senses-dd linear both!important;animation-timeline:view()!important;animation-range:entry 0% exit 0%!important}}
</style><style data-tdb-senses-tap-highlight>[data-tdb-senses-open],.tdb-senses-loading *,.tdb-senses *{-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}</style>

<script defer src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/TheDentalBarns/tdb-webflow-runtime@0ca09e55c6fc3325ad3a964b17b88832c84eed56/dist/tdb-calculator-loader.js"></script>
<script data-tdb-calculator-launch-icons>
(()=>{const icon='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.25" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="5" y="2" width="14" height="20" rx="1"/><path d="M8 6h8v4H8zM8 14h1m3 0h1m3 0h0M8 18h1m3 0h1m3 0h0"/></svg>';function update(){document.querySelectorAll('[data-tdb-calc-open],a[href$="#treatment-calculator"],a[href="#dental-calculator"]').forEach(a=>{if(!a.matches('.button')&&!a.closest('[data-tdb-calc-entry]'))return;if(a.querySelector('[data-calculator-icon]'))return;a.querySelectorAll('.icon-embed-xxsmall,.icon-embed-xsmall').forEach(n=>n.remove());const i=document.createElement('span');i.className='icon-embed-xxsmall w-embed';i.dataset.calculatorIcon='';i.innerHTML=icon;a.append(i);a.classList.add('is-icon');});}update();if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',update,{once:true});})();
</script>
<script data-tdb-process-navigation>
(()=>{
if(!/^\/(?:first-visit\/?$|services\/|treatments\/|areas\/)/.test(location.pathname))return;
const mobile=matchMedia('(max-width:767px)');
const reduced=window.TDBMotionPolicy.reduced;
document.querySelectorAll('.service-process_sticky').forEach(rail=>{
 if(rail.hasAttribute('data-tdb-process-nav'))return;
 const entries=[...rail.querySelectorAll('.service-process_item[href^="#"]')].map(a=>({a,target:document.getElementById(a.hash.slice(1))})).filter(x=>x.target);
 if(!entries.length)return;
 rail.setAttribute('data-tdb-process-nav','');
 let active=-1,frame=0,lastY=-1;
 function center(i){
  const a=entries[i].a.getBoundingClientRect(),r=rail.getBoundingClientRect();
  rail.scrollTo({left:Math.max(0,Math.min(rail.scrollWidth-rail.clientWidth,rail.scrollLeft+a.left-r.left+a.width/2-r.width/2)),behavior:reduced.matches?'instant':'smooth'});
 }
 function update(){
  frame=0;
  if(!mobile.matches)return;
  const y=window.scrollY;
  if(y===lastY)return;
  lastY=y;
  const edge=rail.getBoundingClientRect().height+innerHeight*.2;
  let i=0;
  entries.forEach((x,n)=>{if(x.target.getBoundingClientRect().top<=edge)i=n});
  if(i!==active){active=i;center(i)}
 }
 function schedule(){if(!frame)frame=requestAnimationFrame(update)}
 addEventListener('scroll',schedule,{passive:true});
 addEventListener('resize',()=>{lastY=-1;active=-1;schedule()},{passive:true});
 rail.addEventListener('click',e=>{
  const a=e.target.closest('.service-process_item[href^="#"]');
  if(!mobile.matches||!a||e.button||e.metaKey||e.ctrlKey||e.shiftKey||e.altKey)return;
  const entry=entries.find(x=>x.a===a);
  if(!entry)return;
  e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();
  const top=window.scrollY+entry.target.getBoundingClientRect().top-rail.getBoundingClientRect().height;
  if(location.hash!==a.hash)history.pushState(null,'',a.hash);
  window.scrollTo({top:Math.max(0,top),behavior:reduced.matches?'instant':'smooth'});
 },true);
 update();
});
})();
</script>
<script data-tdb-smile-design-hero>
(()=>{
 if(!/^\/services\/smile-design\/?$/.test(location.pathname))return;
 function start(){
  const button=document.querySelector('main a[href="#All-treatments"]');
  if(!button)return;
  button.setAttribute('href','#VIP');
  button.setAttribute('aria-label','Join the Smile Design Waitlist');
  button.firstElementChild.textContent='Join the Smile Design Waitlist';
  button.querySelector('.is-down')?.classList.remove('is-down');
 }
 if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',start,{once:true});else start();
})();
</script>
<script data-tdb-instagram-staging>
/* TDB Instagram bootstrap v0.6.4. Pin 2fad009b6d71d82938b09240cd47704a81fbb044 after committing. */
(() => {
  if (!['dentalbarns.webflow.io','thedentalbarns.com','www.thedentalbarns.com','thedentalbarns.co.uk','www.thedentalbarns.co.uk'].includes(location.hostname)) return;
  const widgets = ['d03f7f34-0953-4575-946c-bca5b6a21bed','9abfdbc1-5cc2-4de0-bf56-1093d967c2be','35374f05-af95-4b8c-9480-e091c19319c8','3cbfb5f1-fbeb-4c0c-b53c-6a91daa4aa04'];
  const mounts = [];
  widgets.forEach(id => document.querySelectorAll('.elfsight-app-' + id).forEach(node => {
    node.classList.remove('elfsight-app-' + id);
    node.removeAttribute('data-elfsight-app-lazy');
    node.dataset.tdbIgWidget = id;
    node.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
    const status = document.createElement('span');
    status.className = 'tdb-ig-loading';
    status.textContent = 'From our Instagram';
    node.replaceChildren(status);
    mounts.push(node);
  }));
  if (!mounts.length) return;
  const script = document.createElement('script');
  script.src = document.documentElement.dataset.wfPage === '677cf86df9952f978d94d8a9' && matchMedia('(min-width:992px)').matches
    ? 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/TheDentalBarns/tdb-webflow-runtime@37ca9147f41e4ab45af4e3619147f1de4048f2e6/dist/tdb-home-desktop-instagram.js'
    : 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/TheDentalBarns/tdb-webflow-runtime@37ca9147f41e4ab45af4e3619147f1de4048f2e6/dist/tdb-instagram-feed.js';
  script.dataset.tdbInstagramJs = '0.6.4';
  script.onerror = () => mounts.forEach(node => {
    node.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = 'https://www.instagram.com/thedentalbarns/';
    link.target = '_blank';
    link.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
    link.textContent = 'View our Instagram';
    node.replaceChildren(link);
  });
  document.head.append(script);
})();
</script>
